case_number: 2025 INSC 248; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No.16358 of 2024)
summary: Second FIR quashing challenged; test of 'sameness' of offences; abuse of process if same transaction; further investigation vs fresh FIR; prior sanction under Prevention of Corruption Act mandatory; High Court's quashing upheld; twin safeguards: double jeopardy and fair investigation; appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 2018 s.7, s.7A, s.8, s.12
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.154, s.156, s.167, s.173, s.482
Constitution of India Art.19, Art.21, Art.226, Art.227
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of High Court upholding quashing of second FIR sustained.
